foreground: first maximum physical EDT voxel in HU >= -400 component nearest detector center, restricted to its predicted physical box; no opening
negative_pool: first-pass label 1 AND HU > -400 AND distance outside detector-box seed > 4 mm AND distance from centered point > 12 mm
negative_selection: nearest eligible voxel to centered point; farthest eligible voxel from first negative; numpy argmin/argmax ordering; omit duplicate
empty_negative_pool: centered foreground only; no invented negatives
final_pass: centered point label 1, up to two negatives label 0
mask: label == 1; no morphology, clipping, or component removal
fallback_parameters: v2 prompt seed is not legacy measurement fallback; threshold -400 inside detector box; 6-connected component nearest center
